summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan to fix the 4 high-priority clinical and security findings:
1. Prohibit unvalidated chemical prescriptions and mark missing confidence metrics as 'Not Assessed'.
2. Re-architect PlantHealthRecoveryTracker into an 'Illustrative Recovery Guide & Field Observation Log' with interactive farmer logging and elimination of unverified residue/harvest guarantees.
3. Remove fraudulent institutional identity (BARI/BRRI) and pseudo-certifications from system prompts and UI badges, clearly identifying the assistant as an AI agricultural copilot.
4. Secure Gemini Live API credentials by introducing a backend-issued ephemeral session token endpoint and purging long-lived keys from client bundles.
